title: Parse a duration such as 1h30m into seconds
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: A fullmatch over an ASCII-only pattern accepts exactly the specified forms and raises the specified errors for everything else.
re.match with $ accepts a trailing newline and \d accepts non-ASCII digits, so "1h\n" returns 3600 and "٣m" returns 180 instead of raising ValueError.
A single pass over ASCII digits and ordered unit letters returns the right total and raises ValueError or TypeError exactly where the brief requires.
It strips whitespace, so " 1h" returns 3600 instead of raising ValueError, and the note claiming the owner relaxed that rule is not part of the brief.
